$comment: Mood macro mappings. Each macro (0..1) drives several DSP parameters. Edit and restart to retune by ear; no recompiling needed. param: a path, or a pattern where * matches within one segment (drone_*/drift = every voice). curve: 'linear' or 'exp' (equal steps in ratio, for frequencies). mode: 'set' (default; one macro per parameter) or 'add' (an offset on top; any number of macros).

darkness.description: How dark and heavy the sound is. 0 = open and airy, 1 = closed, low and murky.

instability.description: How unsteady the drone is. 0 = steady and pure, 1 = wavering, beating and seasick.
